moat_against: OEM customer concentration and annual pricing pressure — a price-taker, not a price-maker
GAAP ROIC proxy declining (10.2% in 2023 to 5.7% in 2024 to 4.9% in 2025) with recurring impairment/restructuring charges
Cyclical light/commercial vehicle production exposure; gross margin only ~18-19%
EV transition pace risk and a weak Battery Energy Systems segment (Q2 2026 sales -37.1% YoY, still loss-making)
moat_for: Designed-in content with platform-life switching costs — once certified into a vehicle platform, removal requires re-engineering
Diversified propulsion portfolio (turbos/thermal, drivetrain/transfer cases, PowerDrive e-products) hedges ICE, hybrid and BEV paths
Scale and systems-integration capability (integrated drive modules, eTurbo, 800V inverters/SiC) few tier-1 rivals match
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 10.7% in FY2025 and 11.3% in Q2 2026 on cost control
moat_justification: Leading designed-in positions in turbos, transfer cases and e-propulsion with platform-life switching costs, but an OEM price-taker in a cyclical industry: GAAP ROIC proxy fell from 10.2% (2023) to 4.9% (2025) on recurring impairments/restructuring, gross margin is only ~18-19%, and the EV transition plus the loss-making battery segment erode durability.
name: BorgWarner Inc.
one_liner: Solid cyclical auto supplier, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% at $58.13 (13.1% weighted IRR, IV@15% $49.20); clears the 15% hurdle only below $49.20, size to the bear end (Tier C).
